shadows.purpose: Outline the selected issue without floating elevation.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Button state feedback; disabled with reduced motion.

motion.name: review-appear
motion.purpose: Opacity 0.75 to 1 and translateY(3px) to none; disabled with reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button-primary {font: 550 15px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; border: 1px solid #d1d9e0; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease-out; background:#1a7f37; color:#fff;border-color:#1a7f37;}.ds-button-primary:hover {background:#146c2e;} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0969da; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled {opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed;} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button-primary {transition:none;} }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary {font: 550 15px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; border: 1px solid #d1d9e0; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease-out; background:#fff; color:#1f2328;}.ds-button-secondary:hover {background:#f0f3f6;} .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0969da; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled {opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed;} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button-secondary {transition:none;} }

components.name: Search field
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="搜索当前页" placeholder="搜索标题、仓库或编号" type="search">
components.css: .ds-input {font:13px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans",sans-serif; border:1px solid #d1d9e0; border-radius:6px; padding:9px 11px; background:#fff; color:#1f2328; min-height:42px; caret-color:#1a7f37;} .ds-input::placeholder {color:#687380;} .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0969da; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pending status
components.css: .ds-status {display:inline-block; font:12px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans",sans-serif; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 9px; background:#fff5d9; color:#795b0b;}

components.name: Inbox surface
components.description: Flat bordered workspace containing list and evidence.

components.name: Active scope
components.description: Current scope is both colored and semantically selected.

components.css: .ds-nav {font: 550 15px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; border: 1px solid #d1d9e0; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease-out;background:#eaf4ed; color:#17662e; border-color:transparent;} .ds-nav:hover {background:#f0f3f6;} .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0969da; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet operational workspace for reading issue evidence and explicitly confirming labels.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white surfaces and visible seams
dos: Return to the mobile list after successful actions.
donts: Do not equate confidence with correctness.
Do not render issue content as trusted HTML.
